title: Terminate owned descendants after their immediate parent exits
body: bounded skips process-group cleanup when the immediate parent has exited, leaving its pipe-inheriting descendant running after HelperTimeout. Actual public-boundary reproduction confirms parent exit0 and live same-group child. T159 requires bounded cancellation/no orphan.
requested_change: Boundedly terminate the private owned group independently of leader poll status; preserve safe already-gone/parent reaping and add real early-parent-exit plus termination-resistant-descendant controls.
